results.title: India’s efforts to clean its air need not slow its economic growth
results.content: The best interventions must address air pollution while supporting development priorities. Cleaner industrial processes may reduce emissions while improving efficiency. Clean cooking can reduce household smoke while improving convenience and health. Better waste management can reduce open burning while improving urban services
